tasks.short: Mark tyres record times and check overstays

steps.what: Identify the vehicle and parking location, read the applicable local limit and verify that the assigned marking operation may proceed
Mark tires of parked vehicles with chalk and capture the actual marking event time at the handheld {OPS_SYSTEM} device
Enter the exact vehicle, location and marking time into the {OPS_SYSTEM} marking record
Check the marking record against the actual vehicle, location, event time and observed chalk mark and correct mismatches
Save the marking entry in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} record
Return at regular intervals to the actual location, identify the vehicle and mark and capture the actual return time
Calculate elapsed time from the exact captured marking and return times against the selected limit in {OPS_SYSTEM}
Assess the actual return observation and elapsed-time comparison to determine whether the parking limit may have been exceeded

tasks.design: Configure exact marking-record fields and elapsed-time calculation in {OPS_SYSTEM} from actual event captures. The worker marks, returns and checks physical evidence; a numerical overstay comparison does not issue a citation.
tasks.previous_blocker: A chalk-marking workflow may require time/reference re-entry and manual elapsed-time arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native handheld event fields and explicit time calculation can remove those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Vehicle identity, movement, mark condition and evidential limits need direct observation.
tasks.human_edge: The worker recognises when elapsed time alone is insufficient evidence.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for operational authority, location-data access and national staff consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact event-time recording and elapsed-time calculation can be configured while physical marking and enforcement judgement remain human.

assumptions: Representative episode is the stated chalk-marking process only where it is actually authorized locally; this is not a legal claim that the practice is generally permitted. S1 counts actual identity, location and rule selection; s2 captures the actual event time and s6 the actual return time. No plate-recognition feed or inferred vehicle presence is assumed.

S3 explicitly populates the record and s7 calculates elapsed time. Manual identification, capture and complete record checking remain. Missing identity, uncertain timestamps or disputed marks require manual investigation. Native configuration first; existing automatic timestamps and comparisons earn no new gain.

A1 is the actual immediate readiness for physical marking, not self-approval of a record. It binds the exact vehicle, location and locally assigned operation; changes require another check. The ordinary record save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated.

Citation writing, issue and contested-case handling are separate actions if the assessment leads to them; none is hidden here. Shared marking records are counted once with 7953. Shares are provisional active work, not measured patrol timings.
unknowns: Actual local marking authority and process
research_questions: Which event-record transfers and elapsed comparisons are still manual?

already_counted.description: Physical identification and event capture, full marking-entry checks, return observation and overstay assessment remain.

incremental.description: Check time-field and local-limit configuration after controlled changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact vehicle, location and authorized marking operation checked in s1; changed context voids readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80, gross=20; upkeep 2 gives net 18. Low zero where handheld capture already writes the event and computes elapsed time, so add no duplicate configuration. All marking, travel and evidence judgement remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify actual enforcement event records and contested-citation case updates and capture the required record scope and field mappings
Transfer exact case identifiers, event times, locations and already recorded status references into the required {OPS_SYSTEM} log and case-record draft
Match exact event and case keys and flag missing required fields or duplicate references in {OPS_SYSTEM}

Prepare and maintain required records, including logs of parking enforcement activities and contested citations, writing actual context, resolving exceptions and checking every entry against original sources
Save the completed entries in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} records without changing a citation decision or sending a notice

tasks.design: Configure exact event and case-field population plus required-field and duplicate-key checks in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The worker resolves gaps and writes and checks all actual record context; software neither invents an event nor decides a contested citation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Required logs may repeat fields already captured in event and complaint records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked records and deterministic key checks can remove the repeated transfer and matching.
tasks.still_hard: Missing evidence and conflicting case narratives require original-source investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The worker distinguishes a clerical gap from an unsupported enforcement claim.

ambition.what: No new enforcement or complaint decision right.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for record access, privacy and control review; national staff consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact enforcement-event imports and key checks can support required record maintenance without deciding citation validity.

assumptions: Boundary is actual required log and contested-case record maintenance with repeated transfer. Field workers and complaint handlers produce existing event/case records during their ordinary work; s1 verifies those sources and counts scope and mapping capture. New source recording is not made free. Missing or conflicting sources remain manual exceptions.

Exact fields are event/case identifiers, actual timestamps, locations and already recorded decision/status references. S2 explicitly transfers and s3 explicitly checks keys; no semantic entity match or new case decision is inferred. Native configuration first; existing linked logs earn no new gain.

S4 retains all actual narrative capture, exception resolution and original-source checks. The ordinary same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without author self-approval. It does not enact a citation-status change or send a notice.
Records shared with 7938 and 7944 are counted once, not duplicated in a role roll-up. Shares are hypotheses, not measured record-maintenance baselines.
research_questions: Which required records still duplicate event and case fields manually?

already_counted.description: Source verification and mapping capture, actual narrative and complete exception/source checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain mappings and test missing-field and duplicate-key handling after source changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55, gross=45; upkeep 4 gives net 41. Conservative case: fragmented sources leave only 11 transfer/key-check points avoidable, giving 11-4=7. Actual narrative and case-evidence investigation stay human.

tasks.short: Investigate answer and route citation complaints

steps.what: Locate and read the actual complaint, citation and evidence references in {OPS_SYSTEM}
Investigate the contested citation by reading original evidence and obtaining the actual missing account and context
Write the actual findings and supported response and routing options in {OPS_SYSTEM}, checking every statement against original evidence

Investigate and answer complaints regarding contested parking citations by making the actual delegated determination of validity and exact appropriate routing and selecting the corresponding completed response
Save the actual findings and determination in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} complaint record
Route the exact complaint snapshot to the selected internal competent recipient through {OPS_SYSTEM}
Send the exact selected answer to the verified complainant through {OPS_SYSTEM}

tasks.design: Configure exact citation links and case-reference fields in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The worker investigates the evidence, writes supported response options and makes the actual validity and routing determination; both routing and the complainant answer remain distinct human actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaint handling may repeat citation lookup and case identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and fixed references can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting evidence, actual authority and a fair explanation require human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The worker identifies when a citation cannot be supported or must go to a different authority.

ambition.what: No automated validity ruling or appeal rejection.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for complaint access, authority and privacy review; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: citation-linked complaint forms can reduce lookup and exact reference entry while evidence investigation and validity decisions remain human.

assumptions: Representative episode is a worker with actual delegated complaint assessment and routing authority; this must be confirmed, not invented. Citation issuers and complainants produce existing source records; s1 matches them, s2 investigates missing facts and s3 counts all findings and response drafting. Missing evidence remains unresolved, not inferred.

S4 is the task's actual case-validity and routing decision, not a new self-approval step for authored text. Supported response options exist in s3 before selection. If no matching accurate response exists, return to s3 and then make the actual s4 decision on that final version. Where validity is outside this worker's authority, only refer the case and send an accurate pending/referral answer; model the real decision-maker separately rather than assuming a free ruling.

A1 and a2 bind only the exact selected routing, case determination, response and recipient; any edit requires a renewed actual case decision. No automatic cancellation, penalty or appeal determination occurs. Both sends retain full effort; no new time is banked from them. Ordinary save is minimum share 1 for negligible active work, fully retained and ungated.

Native case configuration first; existing links earn no new gain. Exact case references alone default, not a legal interpretation or response meaning. Shared case writing with 7953 is counted once. Shares are provisional, not measured complaint baselines.
research_questions: Which repeated case-reference operations remain after native complaint views are used?

already_counted.description: Source reading, investigation, all response writing/checks and actual case determination remain.

incremental.description: Check citation-reference defaults after case-system changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact case snapshot and internal recipient selected in actual s4 determination; any edit voids the selection
Exact supported response, case determination and complainant selected in s4; any edit voids the selection

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94.15, gross=5.85; upkeep 2 gives net 3.85. Low zero where existing complaint views already link citations and references, so no duplicate tool is introduced. Investigation, decision and both actual sends retain all effort.

tasks.short: Train new and temporary enforcement staff

steps.what: Open and read current parking-enforcement training instructions and local examples in {DOCS}
Train new or temporary staff through actual explanation and demonstration of assigned parking-enforcement work
Observe actual trainee practice and discuss errors, limitations and further learning needs
Write and check the actual required training activity and feedback entry in {LMS} after the session and practice
Save the actual training entry in the same {LMS} record without granting operational authority

tasks.design: Configure direct current-training links in {DOCS}. The worker delivers the training, observes actual practice and writes the required {LMS} entry afterwards; the tool does not infer competence or grant enforcement authority.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current local examples can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled-source links can reduce retrieval work.
tasks.still_hard: Trainee mistakes and understanding must be observed directly.
tasks.human_edge: The trainer recognises when apparent confidence does not match safe practice.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for training-source access and national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct training-source links can reduce retrieval while actual instruction and practice assessment remain human.

assumptions: Representative episode has an actual required training activity/feedback entry. It does not invent a report for every informal explanation. If no entry is required, remove it and recalculate. Source owners produce current instructions; s1 reads and checks them. Missing sources require manual preparation.

S2 delivers actual training and s3 observes practice before s4 captures and checks the activity and feedback. No free transcript or competence score is assumed. Trainee practice is unchanged baseline participation, not newly transferred labour.

Native links first; existing access earns no gain. Ordinary same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without self-approval. Actual qualification or operational authorization, if required, must be a separate genuine decision by the responsible authority after evidence exists.
Shares are provisional active effort, not measured training times. No once-per-course setup is priced into every trainee session.
research_questions: Which current-training retrieval actions remain repeated?

already_counted.description: Source reading, actual teaching, practice observation and full training-record capture/checks remain.

incremental.description: Check training links after local instruction revisions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=98, gross=2; upkeep 1 gives net 1. Low zero when current instructions already open directly, so add no redundant tool. Training, observation and record meaning do not shrink.
